title: Abandoned Art Studio
description: A derelict room filled with scattered and wall-mounted portraits of a dark-haired woman. The wooden floor and walls are heavily splattered with paint, featuring a spiral staircase on the left, two doors in the background, and canvases leaning against surfaces under dim atmospheric lighting.
prompt: Interior of a decaying Victorian art studio with a wooden spiral staircase on the left, multiple doors, and walls completely covered in painted portraits of the same mysterious dark-haired woman. Canvases and prints of her face are scattered across the paint-splattered wooden floor. Dramatic cinematic lighting with rays coming through high windows, heavy paint textures and drips in deep purple, red, and teal tones, moody and unsettling atmosphere.
